cells.quote: Wu et al. (2021) conducted another more recent meta-analysis in which they considered results from 68 longitudinal studies and found that prior achievement significantly predicted subsequent self-concept (β = .16, p < .01) after accounting for prior self-concept.
cells.note: The study text reports a meta-analytic longitudinal association, not a randomized treatment comparison; the treatment/comparison contrast is represented as higher versus lower prior achievement.

cells.quote: Wu et al.50 conducted a randomised control trial where students trained on either simulated patients and an eye model, or only on a simulated patient using a 3D printed eye model, and found that training with an eye model improved fundus identification rate and time.
cells.note: The review reports improvement but provides no numerical effect size or timing.
